caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular swatch of textile, divided into two sections of different textures and colors. The left section is composed of a tightly woven fabric featuring a grid-like pattern with alternating small reddish and greenish-brown squares, giving it a checkered appearance. The right section is larger and consists of a densely stitched, quilted material in varying shades of pink, with visible undulating stitched lines and subtle hints of purple, suggesting embroidered texture. The two sections are positioned directly adjacent to each other, forming a single rectangular piece, and are displayed on a plain, off-white background. There are no additional objects or embellishments in the surrounding space. In the bottom left corner, a faint inscription of numbers and letters is present.
title: Piece of Shag
